headline: Proposed 68,400 sq. ft. manufacturing building on Clark Avenue wetlands applications reviewed during site walk.
summary: Robert Blanchette and Jim McManus showed the proposed site, the wetland area, and the detention pond area. Borghesi Building and Engineering is the applicant for Applications #2078 and #2079, both for the Clark Avenue project. Questions were to be saved for the next regular meeting, because this was not the time for testimony.
